lines.text: @sai_front sits alone at a kitchen table in the dark.
The screen lights his face blue in the dark room.
His fingers fly across the keys, quick and sure.
He leans back and smiles at the glow.
@laptop_silver sits slim and bright on the table.

writes.note: I drafted a short one-location night scene from the laptop opening, with one spoken line.

reply.rationale: Kept the user's opening beat, split into single beats, and added a short payoff with one line; totals about 14 s by rule 10.
